title: FOI-Bioinformatics/taxbencher pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample ID (biological sample identifier, must match a @SampleID in the gold standard) must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

label.errorMessage: Label (unique identifier for this taxonomic profile) must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

classifier.errorMessage: Classifier name must be provided and cannot contain spaces (use taxpasta profiler names for raw outputs: bracken, centrifuge, diamond, ganon, kaiju, kmcp, kraken2, krakenuniq, megan6, metaphlan, motus)

taxpasta_file.errorMessage: Input file path must be provided and cannot contain spaces. Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet location, then the launch directory.

taxonomy_db.errorMessage: Taxonomy database must be NCBI or GTDB (default: NCBI)

abundance_mode.errorMessage: abundance_mode must be 'direct' (reads assigned directly to each taxon, e.g. Kraken2) or 'clade' (cumulative clade abundances, e.g. MetaPhlAn); leave empty to derive it from the classifier
